descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Tehnologie, informații și mass-media
Location: Bucharest, Romania (Hybrid – 1 day per week in the office; remote work available across Romania)
 Job Description We are looking for an experienced Senior DevOps Engineer with strong expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) to design, implement, and optimize cloud infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines. The ideal candidate will have extensive hands-on experience with Terraform, GitHub Workflows, Kubernetes, and cloud security, ensuring scalable, secure, and reliable infrastructure.
 Key Responsibilities 
Design, implement, and maintain scalable, secure, and resilient cloud infrastructure on GCP.
Manage Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform.
Develop, optimize, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions/Workflows.
Implement and automate infrastructure provisioning, deployment, and operational processes.
Manage containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes.
Develop and maintain Helm Charts for application deployment and release management.
Implement cloud security practices, including GCP Secret Manager, IAM, and Security Command Center.
Monitor system performance, availability, and reliability using monitoring and observability tools.
Collaborate with development teams to improve deployment processes and operational efficiency.
Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers.
Support production environments and participate in on-call rotations when required.
 Required Skills & Experience 
 6+ years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or Infrastructure Engineering.
Strong hands-on expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) .
Expert-level proficiency in Terraform (mandatory) and Infrastructure as Code.
Extensive experience with GitHub Actions/Workflows and CI/CD pipeline management.
Strong knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm Charts.
Experience with GCP security services, including Secret Manager, Cloud IAM, and Security Command Center.
Hands-on experience with monitoring tools such as GCP Operations Suite, Prometheus, Grafana, or New Relic.
Experience with service mesh technologies such as Istio.
Strong scripting/programming skills in Python, Go, Java, Bash, or JavaScript.
Good understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and software development lifecycles.
Experience with AWS or Azure is an advantage.
Knowledge of Ansible or Chef is a plus.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
